theme: Seven Wonders of the Ancient World

checkedAlternates.risk: Both the Great Pyramid and the Mausoleum at Halicarnassus are monumental royal tombs.
checkedAlternates.resolution: The Great Pyramid of Giza is the only surviving Ancient Wonder (group-1), whereas the Mausoleum was destroyed by earthquakes (group-3).

checkedAlternates.risk: Temple of Artemis is one of the Seven Wonders.
checkedAlternates.resolution: It is grouped here by architectural function with classical Greek and Roman temples (group-4).

authorReview.notes: Author factual, ambiguity, and three-locale review complete.
